ValidationRule.description: Share Deal and Shared RM may only change with a Share Deal Status update (approval apply) or by System Administrator.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISCHANGED(Share_Deal__c), ISCHANGED(Shared_RM__c)), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(Share_Deal_Status__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Share_Deal_Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Share_Deal_Status__c, "Pending"), ISPICKVAL(Share_Deal_Status__c, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Share_Deal_Status__c, "None") ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Share Deal and Shared RM can only be set through the Share Deal approval process (or by a System Administrator).
